page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 1919 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear tradeoff between compute speed and storage capacity. The server exhibits weak single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests, placing in the bottom 25%. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression is poor, landing in the bottom 10%. However, memory bandwidth for uncached large blocks is average, and Redis SET operations achieve a stable average of 6.02 million operations per second. Small-model LLM inference also performs at an average level, though larger models result in poor performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge offers a high density of local SSD storage and memory relative to its compute capabilities. This makes it a qualitative match for workloads that require substantial local data caching or high-capacity storage but do not demand top-tier CPU performance. Recommended workloads include local database hosting, caching layers, and general-purpose storage-heavy applications.

Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it delivers a baseline network speed of 2 Gbps. Benchmark data reveals a performance profile where compute capabilities, such as Geekbench and stress-ng scores, reside in the lower 25th percentile, while uncached memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations reach average tiers. This hardware configuration presents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing high local storage density and memory capacity over raw processing speed. Consequently, the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-intensive tasks and is best suited for database hosting, caching layers, and storage-heavy workloads that do not require intensive CPU performance.
